--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.LNS_LADMD

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2023-09-05'

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_SELECT_SRC
(
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_SELECT_SRC
(
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.ACID,
                CC.SHDL_NUM,
                CC.DMD_FLOW_ID,
                CC.DMD_DATE,
                CC.DMD_SRL_NUM,
                CC.DEL_FLG,
                CC.LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                CC.DMD_EFF_DATE,
                CC.DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                CC.DMD_AMT,
                CC.LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                CC.TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                CC.LCHG_USER_ID,
                CC.LCHG_TIME,
                CC.RCRE_USER_ID,
                CC.RCRE_TIME,
                CC.EI_AMT,
                CC.TS_CNT,
                CC.LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                CC.DEMAND_IND,
                CC.LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CC.CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                CC.BANK_ID,
                CC.WAIVED_AMT,
                CC.LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                CC.TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                CC.FEE_TYPE,
                CC.ASSOCIATION_ID,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.LNS_LADMD CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD] B
            ON CC.ACID = B.ACID
            AND CC.SHDL_NUM = B.SHDL_NUM
            AND CC.DMD_FLOW_ID = B.DMD_FLOW_ID
            AND CC.DMD_DATE = B.DMD_DATE
            AND CC.DMD_SRL_NUM = B.DMD_SRL_NUM
            AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_GROUP_SRC
(
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.LNS_LADMD A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ACID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SHDL_NUM,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SHDL_NUM,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.DMD_FLOW_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.DMD_FLOW_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.DMD_DATE,'1900-01-01') = COALESCE(B.DMD_DATE,'1900-01-01')
AND COALESCE(A.DMD_SRL_NUM,'-1') = COALESCE(B.DMD_SRL_NUM,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.LNS_LADMD
(
                ACID,
                SHDL_NUM,
                DMD_FLOW_ID,
                DMD_DATE,
                DMD_SRL_NUM,
                DEL_FLG,
                LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                DMD_EFF_DATE,
                DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                DMD_AMT,
                LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                LCHG_USER_ID,
                LCHG_TIME,
                RCRE_USER_ID,
                RCRE_TIME,
                EI_AMT,
                TS_CNT,
                LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                DEMAND_IND,
                LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                BANK_ID,
                WAIVED_AMT,
                LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                FEE_TYPE,
                ASSOCIATION_ID,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.ACID,
                SRC.SHDL_NUM,
                SRC.DMD_FLOW_ID,
                SRC.DMD_DATE,
                SRC.DMD_SRL_NUM,
                SRC.DEL_FLG,
                SRC.LD_FREQ_TYPE,
                SRC.DMD_EFF_DATE,
                SRC.DMD_OVDU_DATE,
                SRC.DMD_AMT,
                SRC.LAST_ADJ_DATE,
                SRC.TOT_ADJ_AMT,
                SRC.LCHG_USER_ID,
                SRC.LCHG_TIME,
                SRC.RCRE_USER_ID,
                SRC.RCRE_TIME,
                SRC.EI_AMT,
                SRC.TS_CNT,
                SRC.LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,
                SRC.DEMAND_IND,
                SRC.LDT_CRNCY_CODE,
                SRC.CRYSTALLISED_AMT,
                SRC.BANK_ID,
                SRC.WAIVED_AMT,
                SRC.LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE,
                SRC.TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT,
                SRC.FEE_TYPE,
                SRC.ASSOCIATION_ID,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'LNS',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
